poll.notes: n: release gives 830 Florida adults; likely-voter count not stated (270toWin shows 522 LV, RCP/Wikipedia 830) so left null. The October report says September was later re-estimated with a 2024-recall anchor; these are the September release's own numbers.

pollster.weighting_quote: The sample was weighted by age, race, ethnicity, education, gender and region to reflect the Florida adult population. Likely voters were identified using a modeled turnout score
